_metadata.title: Research-enriched internal component layout map
_metadata.required_image_orientation: portrait/upright phone, rear cover removed, camera cluster at top, device tightly cropped with minimal background
_metadata.critical_warning: The component identities and general topology are grounded in cited teardown/repair sources. The normalized boxes are NOT measurements from those source images and cannot be universally 'real' without calibrating them to the exact internal image file used in your app.
recommended_workflow: Choose one licensed/owned teardown image per model.
Crop it consistently to the device boundary.
Open it in an annotation tool.
Adjust the normalized boxes in this JSON.
Set coordinate_status to calibrated_to_reference_image after verification.

s25_edge.architecture_notes: iFixit documents the logic board, two rear cameras, front camera, earpiece speaker, modular USB-C port, sub-board, wireless charging/loudspeaker assembly and thin central battery. The thin chassis changes component geometry relative to the Ultra models.

component_relationships: Rear cameras attach to the logic board with separate press connectors.
USB-C port is modular and serviced separately.
Sub-board is a distinct lower-board assembly.
Wireless charging and loudspeaker assembly is removable as an upper assembly during disassembly.
